doc.title: Bill Goodwin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 28, 2025

title: Joe Williams and the founding of the Fillius Jazz Archive
summary: Rowe explains how Joe Williams and Milt Fillius started the oral history project.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: Among the other people that I was going to ask you about was Joe Williams.
Because he helped get this project started years ago and was a very dear friend.
No, I thought that — did he go to college there or is from the college?

No he did not. He befriended a fella named Milt Fillius who did go to college here, class of ’44, and Milt Fillius was a tremendous jazz fan and supporter, almost like a patron. He got to know Joe and so around 1993 they decided that too many musicians were passing away without getting their stories told. And so we started this project and Joe lent his reputation to it. He did some interviewing for us and he received an honorary degree from Hamilton College and — © Fillius Jazz Archive -17-
